architecture: No new member planner, charge-revision ledger, result store or comparison calculator.
Existing frozen external registrations, member IDs, keyed submissions/result/assessment receipts, cumulative usage and comparison summaries remain authoritative.
Three sequential production A/B experiments; masking and same-state replay are test-only controlled environments.
Terminal summary overhead is included by common Eval normalizer v4; cost/phase breakdowns are never added again.
Safe streamed member records retain all expected states, unknown usage/prices, metadata coverage and bounded cleanup outcomes.
regressions: Deliberate artifact/location/constraint/ID/factual-support corruption fails scoring; malformed JSON creates a failed check.
Private truth canary/future questions stay outside execution projections and generic catalog instructions.
Controlled replay clones independent local fixtures with equal start hashes and no external side-effect duplication.
Public result/assessment writes validate against current OpenAPI.
Missing/confounded SDK/lock/build/models/thresholds, duplicate/oversize manifests fail before dispatch; model aliases are checked against published resources rather than an invented grammar.
Lost acknowledgement replays the same member key; timeout cancels and joins; budget/unknown usage stop further dispatch without dropping expected failures.
Current server comparisons own denominators/conclusions; stale or incomplete coverage cannot become success.
Private observer process groups are bounded and joined; optional diagnostic failure does not replace execution results.
limitations: Offline scored records verify fixtures/scorers/consumer only; no live quality or token savings are claimed.
Runtime build and capability/instruction/Skill equality use explicit operator attestations where current public APIs have no discovery reader.
LikeC4 pilot scorer checks a dependency projection, not full-project compilation.
Tiny cases that never produce useful post-checkpoint work cannot establish compaction quality; V417-010 owns live/held-out evidence.
Cooperative observed-token limits may include an in-flight member overshoot; the harness adds no new Runtime hard limiter.
Full release-verify remains V417-009; shared V417-004 remains last.
exclusions: No live Gateway dispatch, deployment or main merge; optional heavy I/O disabled.
